correctness.rationale: For n>=32 the signed cyclic-gap game strategy preserves row-offset/parity on short gaps and length lower bounds on long gaps with B_s=2^(s+1), hence preserves equality and adjacency after four moves. The integer outputs certify 12 small singleton theories and a shared tail. No finite experiment is used in place of the infinite argument.

value.rationale: The work gives a complete and sharp first-order logical classification of both ordinary and twisted circular ladders, including the exact first width (9) at which an infinite topological difference becomes invisible and the sharp 18-vertex family representative bound. In particular it exhibits planar/nonplanar, differing-graph-complex cubic families with identical rank-four theories and establishes a concrete semantic boundary not covered by the classical cycle classification.
